text_to_image_prompt: A clean white studio landscape full-body character turnaround, front, exact side profile and rear views at equal height and baseline, premium semi-realistic 3D rendering, no labels or watermark. Adult man with tousled deep brown hair, gray eyes, refined jaw, two black feline ears and exactly one long dark tail per view, tall 8–9 head model proportions with long legs and complete waist. Wardrobe: Burgundy shirt · black ankle boots. Keep exactly the garments, shoes, layering and accessories represented in the confirmed asset; use the associated reference for fidelity.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied THREE-VIEW CHARACTER SHEET. Preserve exactly same Rhys face, hair, two cat ears, single long tail per view, tall 8.5–9 head fashion model anatomy, full waist and long legs, all three poses and framing, white studio and premium 3D rendering. No text/no logos. Correct accessory continuity ONLY: in the BACK VIEW (rightmost figure), move black handbag AND silver bracelet from viewer-right hand/wrist to viewer-LEFT hand/wrist, which is the character's LEFT side when viewed from behind. The front figure and side figure must stay completely unchanged. The back-view viewer-right hand is empty and has no bracelet. Tail unchanged one only. Do NOT mirror the whole back body. Keep same entire image layout, clothes, shoes, height and long legs. This is a surgical back-view handbag/bracelet correction.
